  5. ... כי הפקיד[ה]...

texts.citation: Judith Olszowy-Schlanger, Karaite Marriage Contracts from the Cairo Geniza (Boston: Brill, 1997).
texts.html:
1. ... on this day, I will give [them to her]... 
  2. ... [incumbent] upon him, seventy dinars.... 
  3. ... Khalaf and Naḥūm ben Naḥūm, and testified... 
  4. …for her, the mohar... 
  5. ... that he acted as an agent... 
  6. ... the young man, the groom, son of...
